summary: On paper Chicago has the edge (Chicago ranks 2nd in EPA per dropback, +0.29), while New Orleans's best counter is to break tackles (New Orleans ranks 6th in broken tackles per touch, 6.2%). Under center, Caleb Williams ranks 5th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Tyler Shough ranks 16th; x-factor: Chris Olave gets 29% of New Orleans' targets and 46% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.75) ranks 5th of 1211. Chicago's pass defense ranks 9th. The model favors Chicago at 86%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.5 pts) and passing matchup (3.6 pts).
